loc_lasersplus_menu_user_desc: Change your own lasers and flashlights
loc_lasersplus_menu_team_desc: Change your teammates' lasers and flashlights
loc_lasersplus_menu_enemy_desc: Change sniper and other NPC lasers and flashlights
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_subheader_att: These options affect SWAT Turrets that are attacking
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_subheader_rld: These options affect SWAT Turrets that are reloading
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_subheader_mad: These options affect SWAT Turrets hacked by ECMs
loc_lasersplus_gadget_network_sync_desc: Send your gadget colors to other players
loc_lasersplus_laser_redfilter_desc: Teammates' Lasers with too much red will be changed to your Teammate Laser Color.
loc_lasersplus_qol_defaultgadget_desc: Automatically sets newly-purchased laser/flashlight colors and sight attachment textures/colors
loc_lasersplus_button_gadget_multigadget: Click to show a description of the Multi-Gadget options.
loc_lasersplus_dialog_gadget_multigadget:
Disabled: Only one laser or flashlight can be active at once.

Multi-Cycle: Pressing your "Gadget On/Off" keybind $BTN_GADGET will cycle through every combination of your available gadgets in sequence.

EVERYTHING!: Pressing your "Gadget On/Off" keybind $BTN_GADGET will toggle every available gadget at the same time.
loc_lasersplus_qol_blackmarket_colorpick:
Lets you use a colorpicker interface when editing a laser/flashlight attachment.
Requires Colorpicker mod.
loc_lasersplus_qol_defaultgadget_reticle: Change the default reticle image for newly-purchased sight attachments
Change the default reticle color for newly-purchased sight attachments
loc_lasersplus_menu_user_header_desc: Change the appearance of your lasers and flashlights below
loc_lasersplus_menu_team_header_desc: Change the appearance of other heisters' lasers and flashlights below
loc_lasersplus_menu_enemy_header_desc: Change the appearance of NPC lasers and flashlights below
loc_lasersplus_menu_world_header_desc: Change the appearance of vault lasers below
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_header_desc: Change the appearance of SWAT Turret lasers below

loc_lasersplus_generic_flash_range_desc: How far the flashlight can illuminate
loc_lasersplus_generic_flash_strobeenabl: Lets your flashlight shift through color hues in a predetermined pattern.

Amount of green in the laser color
Amount of blue in the laser color
loc_lasersplus_generic_laser_alpha_desc: Opacity of the laser. Higher values are more visible.
loc_lasersplus_generic_laser_radius_desc: Radius of the laser beam cylinder
loc_lasersplus_generic_laser_strobeenabl: Lets your laser shift through color hues in a predetermined pattern.

loc_lasersplus_laser_accurate_desc: Laser beam cylinder points towards actual bullet direction instead of viewmodel weapon direction.
loc_lasersplus_laser_update_override_des:
Enables the Accurate Lasers and Laser Radius options.
You should disable this if you encounter conflicts with other laser mods.
loc_lasersplus_flash_update_override_des:
Enables the Flashlight Fog Effect Alpha option.
You should disable this if you encounter conflicts with other flashlight mods.
